result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban roadway passing under a bridge structure, leading to a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle travel lanes and significant shadows created by the overhead structure.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead bridge creates deep shadows that may reduce the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground under the bridge structure

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island at the crossing to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Add supplemental lighting beneath the bridge structure to improve visibility and eliminate dark spots for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is situated beneath an elevated structure, featuring a wide zebra-marked crosswalk and a central refuge island. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the overhead structure creates significant shadows and potential sightline obstructions from large support pillars.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Pillars
hazards.description: Large structural support columns for the elevated roadway can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway under the structure

hazards.name: Deep Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates high-contrast shadows that may reduce the visibility of pedestrians to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area beneath the blue structure

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Underdeck Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-focused lighting under the structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection located beneath an elevated transit structure, featuring marked zebra crosswalks and paved sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the overhead structure creates significant shadows and potential visual obstructions for road users.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from elevated structure
hazards.description: The pillars and the overhead structure itself create shadows and physical barriers that can hide pedestrians from drivers' view.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the station entrance and pillars are located.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively fast vehicle turns across the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels under the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and increase pedestrian visibility at night or in overcast conditions.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, multi-lane intersection situated beneath a massive elevated structure. Large support pillars and poor lighting under the bridge create significant visual obstructions and a hostile atmosphere for walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The intersection is extremely wide, increasing the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Large concrete pillars supporting the overhead structure block views between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Poor Lighting
hazards.description: The area under the elevated structure is significantly darker than the surrounding environment, reducing visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder style markings to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install additional pedestrian-scale lighting to eliminate dark spots and improve safety under the structure.
